name: 46516 · Elkhart, IN
findings: ZIP 46516 (Elkhart) has 133 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46516 (Elkhart) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46516 (Elkhart) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 7.6 times the typical level).
